definitions.explanation: The period following the death of a close family member during which one refrains from celebrations and New Year greetings.

examples.japanese: {喪中|もちゅう}⟦なので→なので：29354_nanode⟧⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出|だ}しません→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I won't send New Year's cards because I'm in mourning.

examples.japanese: {喪中|もちゅう}⟦ハガキ→はがき：00699_hagaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{十一月|じゅういちがつ}→十一月：00635_juuichigatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I sent mourning notification postcards in November.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{亡|な}くなった→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{喪中|もちゅう}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother passed away, so I'm in mourning this year.

notes:
USAGE: {喪中|もちゅう} refers to the period of mourning, typically lasting about one year after a close family member's death. During this time, people refrain from celebratory activities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {喪中|もちゅう}⟦ハガキ→はがき：00699_hagaki⟧/{喪中|もちゅう}⟦{葉書|はがき}→はがき：00699_hagaki⟧ (mourning notification postcard)
- {喪中|もちゅう}⟦{欠礼|けつれい}→欠礼：29391_ketsurei⟧ (formal term for not sending New Year greetings due to mourning)
- {喪中|もちゅう}⟦につき→につき：17196_nitsuki⟧ (due to being in mourning)

CUSTOMS:
- {喪中|もちゅう}⟦ハガキ→はがき：00699_hagaki⟧ is sent in November-early December to notify friends that you won't be sending ⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧
- During {喪中|もちゅう}, one avoids ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧⟦{飾|かざ}り→飾り：02539_kazari⟧ (New Year decorations), ⟦お{節料理|せちりょうり}→おせち料理：26981_osechiryouri⟧, and other celebratory activities
- The mourning period length varies by relationship (spouse/parents: 12-13 months; grandparents: 3-6 months)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{忌中|きちゅう}→忌中：26041_kichuu⟧ (immediate mourning period, typically 49 days)
